title: 第11章 凡王府签到第12章 凡王被下毒传遍京都
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
简直与他之前修炼的天级上品《九天玉鼎功》有着云泥之别，
犹如那萤火之光与皓月争辉，又似那燕雀之羽与鸿鹄比翼。
仿佛之前如坠云雾的困惑，或者如遮天蔽日的迷雾，一下子都烟消云散了。
困扰萧凡的那火、水、风领域的坚壁，如同纸糊的一般，轻轻一捅，
便土崩瓦解。
又仿佛置身于那火之狂暴肆虐，水之浩瀚无垠、风之疾驰如电的场景中一般。
直到一切都感受的尽善尽美后，
他在心中振聋发聩地大吼一声，“火之领域！给老子破！水之领域！给老子破！风之领域！给老子破！破！破！破！....”
与此同时，
萧凡在突破之际，
刹那，他的房间仿佛被淹没在一个爆裂的场域，一个无尽冰冷的场域，以及一个风之无极的场域相互交织中。
房间中正在体悟这方世界剑道的剑圣叶孤城是最先察觉到异动，
旋即当机立断地以雄浑无匹的修为施展出自己的剑之领域，
将这异动隔绝在这个房间之内。
心中不禁暗自思忖道，“果真是他剑圣叶孤城的主公，这天赋简直是妖孽中的妖孽啊！”，
“自从来到这方世界后，他的脑海中就被强行灌入了关于这个世界的基本情况，包括，武道境界的划分，武者的修炼资质等等。
然而，像主公这样以现今宗师的武道境界就领悟出天人境才拥有的领域，并且还不止一种的，恐怕是千年、万年都难以出现一个的绝世妖孽了。
以他的天赋，
恐怕连那传说中的神境也可以尝试冲击一下了。”
这也让他对自己的主公愈发地心悦诚服了，他剑圣叶孤城可绝不愿辅佐一个碌碌平庸无为之人。

.......
随着时间如白驹过隙般流逝，
萧凡的火、水、风之领域都逐个完成突破，房间中掀起的轩然大波也逐渐平息下来。
凭借这难得的顿悟之机，
萧凡如饥似渴地运转起《太初造化经》的口诀，
体内那犹如汪洋大海般磅礴雄浑的内力罡气，
在他的操控下一遍又一遍地被重新洗练提纯，
如此循环往复，整整持续了九九八十一个大周天，才终于完美的画上了句号！
萧凡停下了《太初造化经》的运转，
细细感受一番后，惊讶地发现自己的修为竟然如潮水般倒退，
几乎退回到了宗师后期刚刚跨入的水平。
这简直就是跌落了两个小境界啊！
然而，萧凡的脸上却没有丝毫的沮丧，
反而满是欣喜若狂，因为这意味着《太初造化经》比他之前修炼的大萧皇朝祖传功法《九天玉鼎功》要强大太多太多了！
content_en:
It is completely different from the heaven-level high-grade "Nine Heavens Jade Cauldron Technique" he practiced before.
Just like the light of fireflies competing with the bright moon, and like the feathers of sparrows competing with the wings of swans.
It was as if the confusion that was like falling clouds, or like the fog that was blocking the sky and the sun, all of a sudden disappeared.
The solid wall in the realm of fire, water, and wind that troubled Xiao Fan was like paper. With a gentle poke,
It falls apart.
It feels like being in a scene where the fire is raging, the water is vast, and the wind is as fast as lightning.
Until everything feels perfect,
He roared loudly in his heart, "Fire domain! Break it for me! Water field! Break it for me! Wind field! Break it for me! Break it! Break it! Break it! ..."
At the same time,
When Xiao Fan made a breakthrough,
In an instant, his room seemed to be submerged in a bursting field, an endless cold field, and a windy field intertwined with each other.
Ye Gucheng, the sword master in the room who was comprehending the swordsmanship of this world, was the first to notice the strange movement.
Immediately and decisively, he displayed his sword domain with unparalleled cultivation.
Isolate this abnormal movement within this room.
He couldn't help but think to himself, "He really is the lord of his Sword Saint Ye Gucheng. This talent is simply the best among monsters!",
"Since arriving in this world, the basic information about this world has been forced into his mind, including the division of martial arts realms, the training qualifications of warriors, etc.
However, for someone like my lord who, with the martial arts realm of today's master, has realized the realms that only heavenly beings have, and there are more than one kind, it is probably difficult for a peerless monster to appear in thousands or ten thousand years.
With his talent,
I'm afraid we can even try to attack the legendary divine realm. "
This also made him more and more convinced of his lord. Ye Gucheng, the Sword Master, would never want to assist a mediocre and incompetent person.
.......
As time passes by like a fleeting moment,
Xiao Fan completed breakthroughs in the fields of fire, water, and wind one by one, and the uproar in the room gradually calmed down.
With this rare opportunity of enlightenment,
Xiao Fan eagerly turned around the formulas of the Taichu Creation Sutra.
The internal energy in the body is as majestic and powerful as the vast ocean,
Being refined and purified over and over again under his control,
This cycle continued for ninety-nine and eighty-one days before it finally came to a perfect end!
Xiao Fan stopped the operation of the Taichu Creation Sutra.
After feeling it carefully, I was surprised to find that my cultivation level had regressed like a tide.
It has almost returned to the level that Grandmaster just reached in his later period.
This is simply a drop of two small realms!
However, there was no trace of depression on Xiao Fan's face.
Instead, he was overjoyed, because this meant that the Taichu Creation Sutra was much more powerful than the ancestral technique of the Great Xiao Dynasty, the Nine Heavens Jade Cauldron Technique, that he had practiced before!
